# Data import 

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
# CONFIGURATION --------------- 
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)

base_dir <- "/work/williarj/williarj/2627_HJH_Thesis/"

# Test directory 
list.dirs(base_dir, full.names = FALSE, recursive = FALSE)

data <- data.frame()
data4 <- read.csv(paste0(base_dir, "data/outputs/experiment_4.csv"))
data5 <- read.csv(paste0(base_dir, "data/outputs/experiment_5.csv"))
data6 <- read.csv(paste0(base_dir, "data/outputs/experiment_6.csv"))
data <- rbind(data, data4)
data <- rbind(data, data5)
data <- rbind(data, data6)
```

# Data manipulation

```{r}
# 1. Rename Q values 
data <- data %>% rename(q_value_pop2 = q_value_pop2_JC)
data <- data %>% rename(q_value_pop1 = q_value_pop1_JA)
data <- data %>% select(-q_value_pop2) # remove, and then decide if we need to 1-pop or now 

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    hybrid_status = case_when(
      str_detect(ind_id, "IND") ~ str_split_i(ind_id, "_", 2),
      str_detect(ind_id, "F1") ~ "F1",
      str_detect(ind_id, "F2") ~ "F2",
      str_detect(ind_id, "B2POP1") ~ "B2POP1",
      str_detect(ind_id, "B2POP2") ~ "B2POP2",
      str_detect(ind_id, "B3POP1") ~ "B3POP1",
      str_detect(ind_id, "B3POP2") ~ "B3POP2"
    )
  )

# JC_orientation means pop1 == JC? -- doesn't necessary align with the BC2POP1 labels
data <- data %>%
  group_by(experiment_ID, bootstrap_ID, run_id) %>%
  mutate(
    JC_orientation = mean(
      q_value_pop1[hybrid_status == "JC"],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) > 0.5,
    
    JC = if_else(
      JC_orientation,
      q_value_pop1,
      1 - q_value_pop1
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Correct labels 
data <- data %>% mutate(
    hybrid_status = case_when(
      # Known pure individuals
      str_detect(ind_id, "_JC$") ~ "JC",
      str_detect(ind_id, "_JA$") ~ "JA",
      
      # F1 / F2
      str_detect(ind_id, "F1") ~ "F1",
      str_detect(ind_id, "F2") ~ "F2",
      
      # B2
      # JC_orientation = True, means that pop2=JC, pop1=JA
      str_detect(ind_id, "B2POP1") & JC_orientation ~ "B2_JA",
      str_detect(ind_id, "B2POP2") & JC_orientation ~ "B2_JC",
      str_detect(ind_id, "B2POP1") & !JC_orientation ~ "B2_JA",
      str_detect(ind_id, "B2POP2") & !JC_orientation ~ "B2_JC",
      
      # B3
      str_detect(ind_id, "B3POP1") & JC_orientation ~ "B3_JA",
      str_detect(ind_id, "B3POP2") & JC_orientation ~ "B3_JC",
      str_detect(ind_id, "B3POP1") & !JC_orientation ~ "B3_JA",
      str_detect(ind_id, "B3POP2") & !JC_orientation ~ "B3_JC",
      
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
)
```

# Cateogrical 
```{r}
# Factor order of the data/categorical variables 
data <- data %>%
  mutate(hybrid_status = factor(
    hybrid_status,
    levels = c("JA","B3_JA", "B2_JA", "F1", "F2", "B2_JC", "B3_JC", "JC")
  ))

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    experiment_ID = factor(
      experiment_ID,
      levels = c(4, 5, 6),
      labels = c("500_loci", "1000_loci", "5000_loci")
    )
  )

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    bootstrap_ID = factor(bootstrap_ID)
  )

```

# Simulated hybrid q distributions 

## Just F1
```{r}
# Gradient from light blue (JA) to dark navy (JC)
blue_palette <- c(
  "JA (Expected)"  = "#A6CEE3",
  "F1 (Expected)"  = "#6BAED6",
  "BC2 (Expected)" = "#4292C6",
  "BC3 (Expected)" = "#2171B5",
  "JC (Expected)"  = "#08306B"
)

grid_data <- data.frame(x = seq(0, 1, length.out = 1000)) %>%
  mutate(
    # Calculate raw densities
    JA  = dnorm(x, mean = 0.00, sd = 0.01),
    F1  = dnorm(x, mean = 0.50, sd = 0.04),
    JC  = dnorm(x, mean = 1.00, sd = 0.01),

    # Standardize each curve by its own maximum
    `JA (Expected)`  = JA / max(JA),
    `F1 (Expected)`  = F1 / max(F1),
    `JC (Expected)`  = JC / max(JC)
  ) %>%
  select(x, ends_with("(Expected)")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -x,
    names_to = "hybrid_status",
    values_to = "density"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    hybrid_status = factor(
      hybrid_status,
      levels = c(
        "JA (Expected)",
        "F1 (Expected)",
        "JC (Expected)"
      )
    )
  )

# Plot standardized curves
gaussian_density_plot <- ggplot(
  grid_data,
  aes(
    x = x,
    y = density,
    fill = hybrid_status,
    color = hybrid_status
  )
) +
  geom_area(
    position = "identity",
    alpha = 0.25,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = blue_palette) +
  scale_color_manual(values = blue_palette) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1.05),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    fill = "Hybrid Status",
    color = "Hybrid Status",
    x = "Proportion of JC ancestry (Q)",
    y = "Standardized density"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank()
  )

print(gaussian_density_plot)

```

# Expected even under known overlayed

```{r}
data_zoom_in <- data %>% 
  filter(hybrid_status %in% c("JC", "F1", "JA")) %>% 
  filter(experiment_ID == "5000_loci")

q_density_plot <- ggplot(data_zoom_in, aes(x = JC)) +
  # Your real data distributions
  geom_density(aes(fill = hybrid_status, color = hybrid_status, y = after_stat(scaled)), 
               alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.7) +
  
  # OVERLAY: Expected/Null distribution centered at 0.5
  stat_function(
    fun = dnorm, 
    args = list(mean = 0.5, sd = 0.08), # Adjust SD to control width
    aes(color = "Expected (0.5)"),
    linewidth = 1, 
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) + 
  # Custom color scale to handle both your factors and the manual line label
  scale_color_manual(values = c("JC" = "#F8766D", "F1" = "#00BA38", "JA" = "#619CFF", "Expected (0.5)" = "black")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("JC" = "#F8766D", "F1" = "#00BA38", "JA" = "#619CFF")) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Density Distribution of Q-values Across Experiments",
    x = "Q-value (1 = JC, 0 = JA)",
    y = "Relative Density",
    fill = "Hybrid Status",
    color = "Hybrid Status"
  ) + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) + 
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(q_density_plot)

```

# Density plot - JA, JC, F1

```{r}
# data_zoom_in <- data %>% filter(JC > 0.75) %>% filter(experiment_ID == "5000_loci")
data_zoom_in <- data %>% filter(hybrid_status %in% c("JC", "F1", "JA")) %>% filter(experiment_ID == "5000_loci")

q_density_plot <- ggplot(data_zoom_in, 
                         aes(x = JC, fill = hybrid_status, color = hybrid_status)) +
  geom_density(aes(y = after_stat(ndensity)), alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) + #, breaks = seq(0.75, 1, by = 0.05)) +
  labs(
    title = "Density Distribution of Q-values Across Experiments",
    x = "Q-value (1 = JC, 0 = JA)",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Hybrid_status",
    color = "Hybrid_status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(q_density_plot)
```
